C1811.title: Turkish KARGU-2 Drone Autonomous Attack Controversy
C1811.summary: A 2021 United Nations Panel of Experts report on Libya said lethal autonomous weapon systems, including the Turkish-made STM KARGU-2, may have been used to pursue retreating personnel during the 2020 conflict and could operate without a continuous data link. Public evidence did not establish whether the system autonomously caused a death, but the incident prompted continuing debate over autonomous target selection, accountability, and international humanitarian law.
